landing.heroSubtitle: Need a helping hand? FixFlix finds helpers near you.
landing.ctaSeekerText: Assembling furniture, small repairs, painting or gardening: just tell us what needs doing.
landing.ctaHelperText: Earn with your talent. Flexibly, in your area and whenever it suits you.
landing.how1Text: Tell us what needs doing and where.
landing.how2Text: We find suitable helpers near you.
landing.how3Text: You arrange the rest directly with each other.
landing.legalNote: FixFlix connects people for everyday help and simple tasks, not for licensed trade services.
landing.detailsIntro: FixFlix is a platform for everyday help. It brings people who need support together with helpers from the same area. Simple, fair and with fixed appointments.
landing.details1Text: You briefly describe what needs doing, for example assembling a shelf, mounting a lamp or tidying up the garden. Then you pick a few days and time windows that suit you. Helpers near you send you an offer with a fixed appointment and price, and you decide whom to choose.
landing.details2Text: You set what you are good at and which area you cover. Then you see matching requests near you and propose the appointment and price yourself. You help whenever it fits your life, occasionally as a hobby or on a regular basis.
landing.details3Text: Assembling and mounting furniture, small repairs, hanging pictures and shelves, painting, garden and outdoor work, help with moving and around the house. Work that legally requires a licensed master craftsman, such as on electrical, gas or water installations, is not arranged through FixFlix.
landing.details4Text: Appointment and price are fixed before anyone comes by. After each job you rate each other, which builds trust in the neighbourhood. You agree on the price in advance and settle payment directly with each other.

privacy.s2Body: This website is served via GitHub Pages (GitHub Inc., USA). When you visit, GitHub processes technically necessary connection data such as your IP address in server logs. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in a secure and stable service (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.s3Body: When you join the waitlist we store your email address, postal code, selected activities, optionally your description or experience level, your answer on whether you would use the app, your language, where your visit came from (e.g. the source of the link) and the time of sign-up. The purpose is to inform you about the launch of FixFlix and to evaluate demand for the product. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time.
privacy.s4Body: Waitlist data is stored with Supabase (Supabase Inc.) in a database in the EU (Frankfurt). A data processing agreement (Art. 28 GDPR) is in place with the provider. We delete your data when you withdraw consent, and at the latest 24 months after sign-up.
privacy.s5Body: We count page views and steps in the sign-up flow to understand how many people are interested in FixFlix. Only the event, the page path, the language and where the visit came from are counted. No IP address, no device identifier, no cookies. The legal basis is our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.s6Body: To keep the waitlist from being distorted or overloaded by automated requests, we limit the number of requests per internet connection. For this, a pseudonymous short value (hash) that changes daily is derived from your IP address and stored for at most 48 hours; we do not store the IP address itself. Before submitting, your browser also solves a small computing task (“I am not a robot”), without third parties and without cookies. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in a secure service (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.s7Body: We do not use cookies and do not store any information on your device.
privacy.s8Body: If you write to us at {{email}}, your message is delivered via the forwarding service ImprovMX to a mailbox at Google (Gmail). We only use your details to answer your request and delete them once they are no longer needed for that. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in answering enquiries (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.s9Body: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and data portability, as well as to object and to withdraw your consent. Write to us at {{email}}. You can also lodge a complaint with a data protection authority.
